_sources._how: Codes the console can receive from the server, gathered from src/growbridge on 2026-11-16 (branch feat/console-usability). tests/web/catalog.test.mjs checks that each one has text in en.js and zh.js; tests/workbench/test_console_known_codes.py checks that the enumerable ones are all listed here. Paths below are relative to src/growbridge.
_sources.state: workflow/states.py: every StageState, RoundState and TaskState value. compute/phases.py: the Phase literal (prepared, queued, running, reconcile, fetching, needs_review, failed, done, cancelled). Conversation status entries: agents/dispatch.py _end records state.value (a TaskState) and 'follow_up' (grep -n '_record(task, "status"' agents/dispatch.py). Not listed: 'awaiting_choice', which the console makes up itself (it has text and a colour group).
_sources.history.event: History rows are written by store.add_history (grep -rn 'add_history(' workflow/). Their event is a Plan(...) event name: literal names from grep -rn 'Plan(' workflow/service.py workflow/recovery.py workflow/store.py (start, pause, resume, stop, takeover, handback, switch_run_sheet, revoke_approval, recovery_exit, onsite_check), 'round_aborted' (workflow/store.py abort_stage), 'restart' and 'recovery_bump' (workflow/recovery.py _enter_recovery callers), and kind.value of a StageEvent for the 12 StageEventKind values (ports.py class StageEventKind; workflow/service.py _plan_event, workflow/store.py pause_plan/recovery_plan/end_actions_plan/expiry_plan).
_sources.history.kind: Interventions are written by store.add_intervention (grep -rn 'add_intervention(\|record_intervention(' .): 'takeover' and 'accepted' from workflow/service.py _intervention callers, 'unexpected_watering' from executor/watchdog.py INTERVENTION.
_sources.history.field: Detail keys of history rows: Plan(detail=...) in workflow/*.py (by, accepted, differences, version, digest, note, confirmed, on_expiry), the 'reason' added in workflow/service.py _commit, and StageEvent details merged in by _commit: executor/engine.py _report callers (grep -n 'self._report(' executor/engine.py: reasons, seconds, state_unreadable, request_ids, differences, rules, confirmed, channel, level, failed, reason, plus right_number added in _report), observer/service.py _pause (rule, alert), observer/frozen_watch.py _pause_event (rule, alert, period). Intervention detail keys: differences (accepted), status_at, off_confirmed, off_confirmed_at, request_id (executor/watchdog.py). The values of 'reason' are free text or event names and the values of 'on_expiry' are 'stop' / 'stay_paused'; neither is listed as a code here.
_sources.history.onExpiry: Values of the on_expiry detail key (workflow/store.py expiry_plan): stop, stay_paused.
_sources.history.reason: executor/outage.py outage_reasons: the 'reasons' list of a disconnect_affects event (due_action, device_differs, unknown_result, gap_too_long).
_sources.alert.kind: Every alert is stored by AlertBook.raise_alert (observer/alerts.py). Kinds found with grep -rn 'raise_alert(\|\.alert(\|_alert(\|_raise(\|_enter(\|self._set(' --include='*.py' . and the module constants they pass: observer/service.py (data_gap, threshold, frozen_watch, stage_checks), observer/frozen_watch.py KIND (frozen_reading), observer/stage_checks.py (task_missed, measurement_missing, measurement_outside_window, audit_finding, audit_task), agents/handlers_auditor.py (audit_finding), executor/watchdog.py (pump_unreadable, pump_unexpected, pump_watchdog), runtime.py (backup_unconfigured, notify_unconfigured, monitor_unconfigured, runtime, tick_step, source_rewound, stage_waiting, task_deadline, run_health, external_monitor, intervention_mirror), runtime_agents.py (agent_task, audit_task, audit_schedule), runtime_backup.py (backup), cli.py (model_client). The kinds are passed through hooks (runtime.alert, watchdog._raise), so the drift test cannot enumerate them; this list is by hand.
_sources.finding: Every Finding code in the server: grep -rn 'Finding(\|_block(\|_hint(' planning/. The run-sheet review (workbench/rounds.py review_json) shows planning/validate.py validate_run_sheet and check_evidence; agents/handlers_common.py check_sheet adds planning/treatment.py (treatment_not_applied); planning/design.py codes come from the design check.
_sources.chat.tool: agents/tools.py ROLE_TOOLS: every tool name of every role. A model may still call a name outside this list; it then shows as unknown.
_sources.chat.role: agents/tools.py ROLE_TOOLS keys (the model roles, agents/dispatch.py records task.owner_role) and 'user' (workbench/rounds.py conversation.add(..., "user", "message", ...)).
_sources.safety.op: archive/models.py Condition.op: Literal['>', '>=', '<', '<='] (the trigger of a safety rule).
_sources.channel: archive/models.py Channel (light, exhaust, fan, pump): Difference.channel, run-sheet channels.
_sources.metric: control/device.py SENSORS keys (the sensors a safety rule or reading can name).
_sources.entry: archive/models.py Entry (workbench/api.py /me sends entry.value, or null, which the console shows as entry.unknown).
_sources.analysis.runState: research/analysis.py RunStatus literal (snapshots[].run_status of GET /protocols/{id}/analysis, workbench/analysis.py state) and AnalysisRun.status (status of POST /analysis/runs, workbench/analysis.py start).
_sources.tickStep: runtime.py Runtime.tick: the first element of each (name, step) tuple handed to _guarded, which is the step name in a tick_step alert's params.
_sources.probe: observer/health.py PROBE_NAMES: the probe names that RunHealth.failures lists (the failures param of a run_health alert).
_sources.heartbeat: runtime.py Runtime._monitor_alerts: the keys of the signals dict (host, run), the signal param of an external_monitor alert.
_sources.findingSource: planning/findings.py SOURCE_ENGLISH: the source kinds of a run sheet finding (validate.py _actions and _evidence_refs yield them); the finding's source param is the entry's own name, shown quoted.
_sources.findingProblem: planning/treatment.py _problem(kind, ...): why a sheet does not apply a treatment (not_host, no_action, other_levels); the console words each item of a treatment_not_applied finding's problems param with findingProblem.<kind>.
